facts.fact: 她答应二十分钟内过去，边洗澡边后悔。
facts.anchor: I promised Brooks I’d be over in twenty minutes, and I’m rethinking that now as the hot water pelts down on my skin.

facts.fact: 白天驯家里最新的马被摔好几次，头发里全是泥。
facts.anchor: My muscles ache from a day of breaking one of our newest horses—and being bucked off him several times—and the mud in my hair is proving especially difficult.

facts.fact: 十九岁搬进小屋——外公从小就留给她和 Everett 的两座之一。
facts.anchor: I moved out here into the cabin when I was nineteen. It’s one of the two cabins Grandaddy Smith earmarked for me and Everett when we were little.

facts.fact: Tansy 画是 Ev 画的，印了几份，她妈妈办公室也有一幅。
facts.anchor: Ev painted it. Got a couple prints done, pretty sure your mom has a matching one in her office.

facts.fact: Ms. Angie 救下三匹被拴路边的马，叫丈夫 Mick 开两马位拖车来接。
facts.anchor: She was one of three horses left tied up at the roadside. Ms. Angie called her husband, Mick, who immediately drove out with a two-horse trailer.

facts.fact: Goody/Clipper 仍在 Fisher 家，Perry 被驯后由外公买下。
facts.anchor: The two boys, Goody and Clipper, still live with the Fishers, but Grandaddy Smith bought Periwinkle from them after we broke her.

facts.fact: Brooks 要她保证不单独驯 Jagger——它才勉强脱野。
facts.anchor: “Shouldn’t be working with him alone. Promise me you won’t, Ash,” he says lowly. “He’s barely greenbroke. You coulda got hurt.”

facts.fact: 她伸手拿鸡翅时被他抓住手腕。
facts.anchor: My fingers are just about to close around a particularly saucy one when his large hand closes around my wrist instead.

facts.fact: 他像太阳月亮一样恒定——她去世界任何角落都知道他会在。
facts.anchor: Brooks has seen me in every stage of life, and like the sun and the moon, he’s constant.

relations: 她十二岁起发誓戒男人却一直暗恋 Brooks
